scripts.check:changed: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:apps && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck:changed && pnpm test:changed
scripts.docker:install: docker compose --profile dev run --rm dev pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir /pnpm/store
